name: Czech Republic
description: The Czech lands from Great Moravia and the kings of Bohemia to Hus, the Habsburgs, Czechoslovakia, 1968, the Velvet Revolution and today.

checkpoints.name: Moravia and Bohemia
checkpoints.note: Great Moravia rose in the 800s, and Bohemia became a kingdom. Charles IV made Prague the capital of the empire and founded its university.

checkpoints.name: Hussites and Habsburgs
checkpoints.note: Hus was burned in 1415, and his followers fought off crusades. The Habsburgs took the crown in 1526, and the Czech language and music revived in the 1800s.

checkpoints.name: Czechoslovakia
checkpoints.note: Czechoslovakia was born in 1918. It was given up to Hitler in 1938, ruled by communists from 1948, crushed in 1968, and freed by the Velvet Revolution.

checkpoints.name: Czech Republic
checkpoints.note: The Czech Republic began in 1993 and joined NATO and the European Union.
